description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_news, which extends HTMLPurifier_URIScheme to validate news (Usenet) URI schemes as per RFC 1738. The class includes a method to validate and sanitize parts of the URI relevant to the news scheme.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_news
classes.description: A class that validates news (Usenet) URI schemes, ensuring certain URI components are nullified and checking compliance with RFC 1738.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the news URI, setting user info, host, port, and query to null, and performing parent validation.
